paths.name: next/link
paths.message: Use @/components/ui/Link (prefetch={false}): ADR-0033 D33.13 invariant N, the portal sends no AUTO prefetch. Only roster/IntentLink.tsx may import next/link.

patterns.message: Next's Link by a deep path is still next/link: use @/components/ui/Link (ADR-0033 D33.13 invariant N).

no-restricted-syntax.message: A FULL prefetch is ruled for one host only, the roster row's IntentLink (ADR-0033 D33.13 point 1). Any other host is an ADR amendment.
